summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of 41.67% of Riches Family Office Limited (the Target) from Riches FO Holdings Limited and Mr. Wu Rui, the registrant's COO. The subsidiary Yingxi Industrial Chain Investment Co., Ltd acquired the stake in exchange for 33,500 shares of Addentax common stock, issued offshore under Regulation S to Mr. Wu Rui. No cash price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed. The board did not name an independent advisor. The transaction closed on June 15, 2026. The stock consideration creates insider alignment but no public arbitrage spread. Watch for future disclosures on the Target's performance and potential further ownership changes.
